query:
UPDATE guild_configs
        SET settings = jsonb_set(
            jsonb_set(
                settings,
                '{verification,useOauth}',
                COALESCE(to_jsonb($2::bool), 'null'::jsonb),
                true
            ),
            '{verification,captchaType}',
            COALESCE(to_jsonb($3::text), 'null'::jsonb),
            true
        )
        WHERE guild_id = $1
          AND settings #> '{verification}' IS NOT NULL;
